content:
Adds an agent to the agent group. You can use the GET /scanners/{scanner_id}/agent-
groups/{group_id} endpoint to verify that the agent was added to the specified agent group.
Requires the Scan Manager [40] user role. See Roles.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
PATH PARAMETERS
integer <int32>
The ID of the agent group.
integer <int32>
The ID of the agent to add.
group_id
required
agent_id
required
